11/21/2025 The 2025 Guangzhou International Automobile Exhibition kicked off on Friday, and Changan Automobile unveiled its CHANGAN DEEPAL, and AVATR brands—presenting over 20 digital and intelligent new products and more than 10 cutting-edge technologies. Changan's open, collaborative approach aligns with Guangzhou's Maritime Silk Road heritage. As China's auto industry transitions from "catching up in technology" to "global expression," Changan is leading the charge with a more technological, confident, and systematic approach, becoming a new ambassador for "Made in China." At the exhibition, Changan combined technology displays, design experiences, and lifestyle scenarios to present its end-to-end capabilities from products to ecosystems, offering visitors an immersive and enjoyable experience. The global debut of the premium urban electric SUV—CHANGAN Q05—stole the spotlight, featuring a next-generation design language, comfort, and space-friendly concepts that attracted many visitors to experience it firsthand. Other highlights included CHANGAN Q07, A07, A06, and CS55PLUS. CHANGAN DEEPAL showcased the newly launched L06, along with the full lineup of models such as the S09, S05, and S07. Meanwhile, AVATR, which defines New Luxury, displayed its high-end, high-tech, and high-value models, including the 11, 12, and 06. During the press conference, Changan introduced "SDA Intelligence," dedicated to delivering "smart mobility solutions with uncompromising safety." Highlights include the SDA Pilot, featuring advanced driving assistance with 360° perception and human-like risk avoidance; the SDA Chassis which enhances handling, comfort, and safety redundancy simultaneously while featuring sustainable evolvability; and the SDA AI OS 4.0, which delivers a safe, comfortable, and intuitive future mobility experience by recreating real-world scenarios, integrating vehicle-wide modules, and incorporating the VLA Assisted Driving Model and an AI Agent. In the Innovation Ecosystem Zone, Changan exhibited futuristic technologies like a Single-Person Wearable Aircraft and Humanoid Robots, outlining its vision for intelligent mobility. Combined with core technologies like SDA Intelligence, Changan demonstrated its strategic roadmap from vision to reality. Changan is expanding its international presence. The CHANGAN Q05, unveiled in Guangzhou, will also debut in Thailand on November 20. Since 2023, Changan has followed a "long-termism" and "localization" approach with the principle of "No Global Presence without Local Bases, No Future Growth without Global Reach." It has completed market layouts in five major regions and is committed to working with global partners to create a new era of smart, sustainable, and win-win mobility. evidence.text: 2026 Changan Nevo Q05 electric SUV with 506km range launched, starting from 11,200 USD China EV Marketplace China EV DataTracker China EVs & More Podcast ICA Reviews EV ICE BYD Xiaomi Tesla Xpeng Zeekr Leapmotor Geely Battery Search EV ICE BYD Xiaomi Tesla Xpeng Zeekr Leapmotor Geely Battery Follow us BYD Xiaomi Tesla Xpeng Zeekr Leapmotor Geely Battery EV 2026 Changan Nevo Q05 electric SUV with 506km range launched, starting from 11,200 USD 2 min to read Nov 21, 2025 11:02 AM CET Liu Miao 0 The new Changan Nevo Q05. Credit: Sohu Understand China EV’s Market Real-time notifications when critical EV data is released All important data in one place 2,000,000+ data points Become a member Changan officially launched its new Changan Nevo (Qiyuan) Q05 electric compact SUV today at the 2025 Auto Guangzhou. The new model, available in six variants, is priced between 79,900 and 109,900 yuan (11,200 and 15,400 USD). Positioned as a pure electric compact SUV, the Changan Nevo Q05 boasts a CLTC maximum range of 506 km. High-end trims will also feature LiDAR. The exterior of the new Q05 adopts Changan Nevo’s “Digital Smart Wing 2.0” design language. The front fascia features a continuous daytime running light strip across the top. Customers can choose from five body colours: Pine Green, Gilt Purple, Moonlight Silver, Cloud Shadow Grey, and Brocade White. The side. From the side, the Q05 features charging ports located on the front fender and semi-hidden door handles. The vehicle measures 4435mm in length, 1855mm in width, and 1600mm (or 1595mm) in height, with a wheelbase of 2735mm. The rear design mirrors the front with a continuous taillight strip and a large roof spoiler. The rear. Inside, the Changan Nevo Q05 offers a wraparound cockpit design, available in two colour schemes: Jade White and Ink Black. The cabin is dominated by a 15.6-inch 2.5K central control screen and a 10.17-inch full LCD instrument cluster. Connectivity features include support for CarPlay and HiCar mobile phone integration, and the system can even connect with Haier smart home appliances. The cockpit. A highlight is the “Tianshu” intelligent driving assistance system. High-end models are equipped with one LiDAR unit, 11 high-definition cameras, three millimetre-wave radars, and 12 ultrasonic radars. This sensor suite enables advanced navigation assistance (NOA) on highways and urban elevated roads. The cabin. The front passenger seat offers a “Queen’s Seat” feature, allowing for a 165-degree recline and leg rest. Both front seats provide heating, ventilation, and massage functions. The interior ambience is further enhanced by 256-colour ambient lighting. The second row. Under the hood, the new Q05 is powered by a front-mounted electric motor delivering a maximum output of 120 kW (161 hp). All variants come standard with CATL’s lithium iron phosphate batteries, offering CLTC cruising ranges of 405 km and 506 km. The vehicle can reach a top speed of 160 km/h and supports 3C fast charging, capable of adding 120 km of range in 15 minutes. Everyone’s a China auto expert lately.
